notes.title: [Event Preview] Qun·Zhao Yun goes online & Limited time sign-in event starts
notes.content:
"Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals" will start multiple activities on December 30, 2023, with new generals, marching animations and gold cake benefits waiting for you to grab.

[b]Event 1: [7C Generals Qun·Zhao Yun Appears][/b]
Event Period: December 30, 2023, 00:00 - January 5, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)
The stirring of the seven serpents shakes the world, and Zhao Yun of 7C Generals makes his debut. As a new 7C general, Zhao Yun has balanced three-dimensional attributes and is a comprehensive output general with a basic martial arts score of over 90 and a growth rate of over 2.5. How will he perform in "Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals"? Come and check it out in the game!

[b]Event Two: 【Limited Time Sign-in to Receive Gifts】[/b]
Event Period: January 1, 2024, 00:00 - January 7, 2024, 23:59 (GMT+8)
During the event, lords can receive benefits simply by logging into the game daily. By accumulating sign-ins for 7 days, you can also obtain the March Animation -- "Shu Hero"

[b]Event Three: [Cumulative Recharge for Gold Pies][/b]
Event Period: 00:00 on January 6, 2024 - 23:59 on January 9, 2024 (GMT+8)
[Recharge Event Rules]
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 1000 Gold, you will receive 1000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 2000 Gold, you will receive 2000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 6000 Gold, you will receive 3000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 10000 Gold, you will receive 5000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 20000 Gold, you will receive 8000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 40000 Gold, you will receive 13000 Gold Pies
*Accumulated recharge reaches a value of 80000 Gold, you will receive 23000 Gold Pies

[Event Description]
Event Period: 00:00 on January 6, 2024 - 23:59 on January 9, 2024 (GMT+8)
The event Gold calculation includes all recharge in the game, including the Trade Route Monthly Pass, various gift packages, Celebrities Experience, etc. The Gold value will be calculated according to its price.
3. During the event, if the accumulated recharge value reaches the specified amount, the corresponding Gold Pie will be returned on January 12, 2024  (calculate the highest accumulated recharge value)
<Example 1>
""A"" can get 3000 Gold Pies back on January 12, 2024, if the accumulated value reaches 6000 Gold during the event period.
<Example 2>
During the event, ""B"" has stored the value of Central Plain Trading (Permanent Monthly Card) and Celebrities Jackpot. The calculation method of Goldvalue is: Central Plain Trading 3380 + Celebrities Jackpot 660 = a total of 3980 Gold. and ""B"" will receive 2000 Gold Pies back on January 12, 2024.
4.The event rewards are expected to be distributed before 20:00 on January 12, 2024 (GMT+8).

If you encounter any event-related issues during the event, contact us through customer service email: [b]Qimousg01@hotmail.com.[/b]
